annotations.title: US wildfires near a point or in a state

description: US wildfires near a point or in a state — Current US wildland fires from the interagency NIFC WFIGS feed: name, acres, percent contained, cause, discovery date, personnel, origin lat/lon. Search by lat/lon + radius (miles, max 500) with distance and a nearby status (FIRE NEARBY / WATCH / DISTANT / NONE), or by state; filter min_acres, active=true, include_rx=true. Public-domain US government data. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_wildfires
